items.title: Aw1-breaker: Sub-millisecond execution circuit breaker for AI agents
items.raw_excerpt: Aw1-breaker is an open-source execution circuit breaker for AI agents that aims to halt runaway agent executions in sub-millisecond time. It is designed to help developers stop failing or looping tool calls and limit resource overruns, with the code available on GitHub.

title_i18n.zh: Aw1-breaker：面向AI智能体的亚毫秒级执行断路器
title_i18n.es: Aw1-breaker: Disyuntor de ejecución submilisegundo para agentes de IA

excerpt_i18n.en: Aw1-breaker is an open-source execution circuit breaker for AI agents that aims to halt runaway agent executions in sub-millisecond time. It is designed to help developers stop failing or looping tool calls and limit resource overruns, with the code available on GitHub.
excerpt_i18n.zh: Aw1-breaker 是一个面向 AI 智能体的执行断路器开源项目，主打亚毫秒级的快速中断能力，用于在智能体行为失控时及时阻断执行。它可帮助开发者在工具调用异常、循环失控或资源消耗过高等情况下保护系统稳定性，相关代码已在 GitHub 上发布。

items.title: Can AI self-improvement overcome diminishing returns?
items.raw_excerpt: The piece examines whether AI recursive self-improvement (RSI) can lead to rapid, runaway capability gains. The author argues that self-improvement is subject to diminishing returns and heavy resource and human-input constraints, so it is more likely to yield gradual progress than an explosive leap to superintelligence.

title_i18n.en: Can AI self-improvement overcome diminishing returns?
title_i18n.zh: 人工智能的自我改进能克服收益递减吗？
title_i18n.es: ¿Puede la automejora de la IA superar los rendimientos decrecientes?

excerpt_i18n.en: The piece examines whether AI recursive self-improvement (RSI) can lead to rapid, runaway capability gains. The author argues that self-improvement is subject to diminishing returns and heavy resource and human-input constraints, so it is more likely to yield gradual progress than an explosive leap to superintelligence.
excerpt_i18n.zh: 文章探讨人工智能能否通过递归自我改进（RSI）实现快速跃升，作者拉梅兹·纳姆认为这种自我强化循环并不会自然导向超级智能。其核心论点是：AI 自我改进同样受制于收益递减，能力提升需要大量外部资源与人类投入，因此更可能是渐进式增长而非爆发式超越。

items.title: AI risk is not sentience by computers, it is negligence by humans
items.raw_excerpt: This opinion piece argues that AI risk stems not from computers gaining sentience but from human negligence and irresponsibility. It calls on Washington state to adopt measures to protect the public from AI-related harm, framing accountability as a human, not machine, problem.

title_i18n.en: AI risk is not sentience by computers, it is negligence by humans
title_i18n.zh: AI风险不是计算机有意识，而是人类的疏忽
title_i18n.es: El riesgo de la IA no es la sintiencia de las computadoras, sino la negligencia de los humanos.

excerpt_i18n.en: This opinion piece argues that AI risk stems not from computers gaining sentience but from human negligence and irresponsibility. It calls on Washington state to adopt measures to protect the public from AI-related harm, framing accountability as a human, not machine, problem.
excerpt_i18n.zh: 这篇评论文章指出，人工智能带来的风险并非源于计算机产生自主意识，而是源于人类的疏忽与失责。作者呼吁华盛顿州采取行动，防范 AI 可能造成的危害，并提出了三项具体建议。文章强调，应对 AI 风险的关键在于人而不是机器本身。
